observations: Three photos show a white PlayStation console with two white DualSense controllers placed on a blue tufted fabric surface.
The console has a vertical black stripe down the center, characteristic of the PS5 Pro model.
The controllers have the standard DualSense design with a four-point touchpad and a D-pad.
No games, cables, or accessories are visible in any photo.
The watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI MC GAMES' is present on all photos.
The seller claims 'Uk used ps 5 pro' and '10 games and two pads up for grabs'.

identity.kind: PlayStation 5 Pro console with two controllers

claims.evidence: No photo shows this clearly enough to read.

claims.claim: 10 games and two pads up for grabs
claims.evidence: No games or additional controllers are visible in any photo. The two controllers are already shown.

claims.claim: Buy peace of mind with Mc_games
claims.evidence: This is a marketing slogan, not a factual claim about the item.

risks.risk: Console may be non-functional or have hardware issues (e.g., disc drive, HDMI, power, cooling).
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and playing a game.

risks.risk: Games may be missing, damaged, or not included as claimed.
risks.proof: Photos of all 10 games with their cases and discs, or a video showing them loaded and playable.

risks.risk: Controllers may be non-functional or have dead buttons/axes.
risks.proof: A video showing both controllers connecting to the console and responding to button presses.

risks.risk: Console may have physical damage not visible in photos (e.g., scratches, dents, or internal damage).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the console's front, back, and sides, including the disc drive and ports.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and booting up.
Photos or video of all 10 games included.
Video of both controllers connecting and working.
Close-up photos of the console's front, back, and sides, including the disc drive and ports.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
